supported_claims: DESCRIPTION declares R>=3.5.0, Rcpp linking, listed imports and GPL-3 at the selected commit; NEWS and check workflow document maintenance intentions, not passing runs.

The selected feols documentation describes recursive singleton/perfect-fit removal and observation/collinearity diagnostics; finite negative weights error, zero weights are removed and missing weights join sample selection.
The selected covariance path reads session defaults; onLoad sets all covariance defaults to iid. Fixed-effect syntax therefore does not itself specify clustered errors.
ssc separates K and G scaling from t degrees of freedom, with none/full/nonnested FE counting and optional exact counting. Upstream tests specify irregular-FE examples but were not run here.
vcov_fix defaults TRUE. The inspected executable branch assigns a repaired covariance only inside if(vcov_fix); its adjacent always-fix comment is inconsistent. The warning threshold is 1e-8.
sunab calendar cohorts absent from supplied period support are classified as never treated. Its own documentation warns about already-treated cohorts outside the observed range.
aggregate.fixest forms sample-share or weighted-share coefficient averages and computes variance using the full coefficient covariance quadratic form.
RM and SD use first and second differences with different tuning units and different zero-tuning assumptions.
Defaults and retained numerical information differ between high-level, low-level and did bridge entrypoints.
Warnings, accepted-grid membership and solver status must accompany any sensitivity result.
Failed LP status can reach a point-target fallback; source reachability is not an observed package failure.
gsynth 1.4.0 is a compatibility wrapper; selected fect 2.4.5 supplies estimation and inference.
The complete selected wrapper declares weight but neither reads nor forwards it; the manual promises a weighted effect.
Method, inference, force, CV, tolerance and output class cannot be inferred from wrapper name alone.
fect distinguishes fit and aggregation weights, rejects different columns in selected source and changes canonical aggregation slots.
Treated-cell and unit averages differ; missingness and removals require explicit denominators.
Counts, predictive rank selection and a finite loading solve do not establish counterfactual stability.
Never-treated donor, reversal and inference gates have explicit source behavior; no universal bootstrap claim.
